hints.title: Sequential Modifications
hints.text: Apply the pairwise check from left to right: if nums[i] == nums[i + 1], multiply nums[i] by 2 and set nums[i + 1] to 0.

hints.title: Zero Compaction
hints.text: After completing all operations, shift non-zero elements to the front while preserving their relative order.

hints.title: Trailing Zero Padding
hints.text: Append zeros to fill the rest of the array up to original length n.

hints.title: Two-Pass Transformation Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass for modifications followed by single pass for zero compaction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated element shifting during iteration causes quadratic copying.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary list to construct the compacted array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Executes the in-order rules without mutation side-effects and compacts zeros cleanly.
